mapper.select:
SELECT owner_id,id,status,current_version_id,metadata_revision AS revision FROM knowledge_item
SELECT owner_id,id,status,current_version_id,revision FROM question
SELECT owner_id,id,status,current_version_id,revision FROM review_recollection
WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT e.attachment_id,e.origin,e.attachment_sha256 AS sha256,e.run_id,e.segment_id,e.locator,e.start_offset,e.end_offset FROM material_excerpt e WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{id}

choose.when: SELECT a.owner_id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.id AS answer_id FROM training_answer a WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.id=#{ref.id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT e.owner_id,e.session_id,e.question_id,e.answer_id FROM ai_evaluation e WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.task_id=#{ref.id}

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_version v WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{ref.id} AND v.id=#{ref.versionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preparation_version v WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{ref.id} AND v.id=#{ref.versionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_version v WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.question_id=#{ref.id} AND v.id=#{ref.versionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_recollection_version v WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.recollection_id=#{ref.id} AND v.id=#{ref.versionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_excerpt e WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{ref.id}

mapper.select: SELECT purpose FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{taskId}

SELECT owner_id,task_id,ordinal,domain, COALESCE(knowledge_item_id,preparation_item_id,excerpt_id,bank_question_id,manual_feedback_id,recollection_id,evaluation_task_id,answer_id) AS source_id, COALESCE(knowledge_version_id,preparation_version_id,excerpt_id,bank_version_id,manual_feedback_id,recollection_version_id,attempt_id,answer_id) AS version_id, manual_feedback_revision AS feedback_revision,observation_id AS feedback_id,report_hash, session_id,training_question_id AS question_id,answer_id,decision_revision,decision_choice,fragment_count,snapshot_hash FROM ai_source_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 6
